definitions.explanation: A symbol in musical notation indicating silence for a specified duration.

examples.japanese: {休符|きゅうふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
examples.english: Count the length of the rest accurately.

examples.japanese: {四分|しぶん}{休符|きゅうふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{四分|しぶん}⟦{音符|おんぷ}→音符：06988_onpu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧だ。
examples.english: A quarter rest is the same length as a quarter note.

examples.japanese: {休符|きゅうふ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧だ。
examples.english: Rests are also part of the music.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{休|きゅう} (rest, pause) + {符|ふ} (symbol, mark)

TYPES OF RESTS:
- {全|ぜん}{休符|きゅうふ} - whole rest
- ⟦{二分|にぶん}→二分：30504_nibun⟧{休符|きゅうふ} - half rest
- {四分|しぶん}{休符|きゅうふ} - quarter rest
- {八分|はちぶん}{休符|きゅうふ} - eighth rest
- {十六分|じゅうろくぶん}{休符|きゅうふ} - sixteenth rest

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{音符|おんぷ}→音符：06988_onpu⟧ - note (musical)
- ⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧ - musical score/sheet music
- ⟦{拍子|ひょうし}→拍子：10495_hyoushi⟧ - time signature, beat
- {小節|しょうせつ} - measure, bar

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休符|きゅうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ - to observe the rest (not play during it)
- {休符|きゅうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{数|かぞ}える→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧ - to count the rest
